name: Australian Street Addresses
description: Street addresses in every layout Australia Post sees: a number (with a letter, a range), the street and its type, the suburb, the state and the postcode, with commas or without, on one line or several, in capitals or lower case, with Australia at the end. Original cases written for this corpus from Australia Post's addressing guidelines and AS4590, described in our own words; nothing copied.
